brief:
The Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission has exposed an acceleration in Israeli colonial expansion across the West Bank, revealing that occupation authorities have reviewed thirteen settlement schemes, Shehab Wire reported. Three of the plans are currently under consideration for approval, the commission said, marking what it characterized as a significant escalation in settlement activity.

The disclosure underscores ongoing efforts by Israeli authorities to expand settlements in occupied Palestinian territory. The commission's findings indicate a systematic approach to advancing multiple projects simultaneously, with some already moving toward formal authorization by Israeli officials.

title: Israeli authorities advance thirteen new settlement plans in West Bank
